name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that stops them from writing bloated code, so you get the smallest working fix instead of an over-engineered mess.
buyer: A startup CTO whose team's AI-assisted codebase is getting expensive and slow to maintain because the AI over-builds everything.
business_use_cases: An engineering lead installs it org-wide so every AI-generated pull request is leaner and easier to review.
A freelance developer offers 'AI code cleanup' audits to clients whose AI-written codebases have become bloated.
A coding-agent vendor bundles a similar discipline layer into its product to cut complaints about verbose output.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'de-bloat your AI-generated codebase' audit and cleanup service for startups.
Build and sell similar discipline/guideline plugins tuned for other pain points (security-first, test-first).

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price 'AI code diet' audit to a startup this weekend: install this, and show them the before/after diff size.
